title: Bronze Gear
description: Yet another bronze mod. It adds bronze tools and armor among other things!
body:
Bronze Gear is another mod that adds tin and bronze. It adds bronze gear that is stronger than iron but less durable.

Tin can be used as a substitute for iron when making a bucket or a cauldron and is now used instead of stone when making repeaters and comparators.

Bronze can be used to make weapons, tools, and armor as well as a whole new blockset.

Additionally, the mod includes a new block called the bronze brazier that acts as an early-game beacon. Simply burn different incense in it and reap passive buffs in a 5 block radius.

More may be added in the future!
